outcome: Quality of maternal and newborn care (QMNC)
Availability of human and physical resources
cohort: Women who gave birth in Portugal from March 1, 2020, to October 28, 2021 (n=1845)
finding: While some aspects of quality of maternal and newborn care remained high in Portugal during the COVID-19 pandemic, substandard practices with large heterogeneity across regions were also reported.
mod_finding: Instrumental vaginal birth rates, fundal pressure use, and episiotomy rates varied significantly across regions.
